# Chez Scheme's example programs

The `examples/*.ss` files of [cisco/ChezScheme](https://github.com/cisco/ChezScheme)
at commit `e3b13636820b13e0feb82b2fb944b60fab4b6e80`, the commit
vendor/chez-mats/ comes from, unmodified. They are Cisco Systems' and the
Chez Scheme authors', under the Apache License, version 2.0 (`LICENSE`,
`NOTICE`).

Chez's mats (`examples.ms` and others) load them; tests/chez-mat.ss adds
this directory to `source-directories`, as Chez's mats find them in
`../examples`.
